articles.title: Implementation Framework for India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement
articles.summary: Ministry of Commerce issues operational norms for the $100 billion investment commitment under TEPA.
prelims: EFTA includes Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, and Liechtenstein.
TEPA features a legally binding commitment for $100B FDI over 15 years.
Excludes sensitive agricultural products and dairy from immediate tariff cuts.
articles.mains: Use to illustrate modern free trade agreement dynamics and foreign direct investment strategies in GS-2 (International Relations) and GS-3 (Economy).

articles.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission: Rollout of SIGHT Program Phase-II Incentives
articles.summary: MNRE expands financial allocations for domestic electrolyser manufacturing and green hydrogen generation.
prelims: SIGHT (Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition) is a major sub-component of NGHM.
Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) serves as the nodal implementing agency.
Target is to produce at least 5 MMT of green hydrogen per annum by 2030.
articles.mains: Cite as a key state intervention for energy transition, industrial decarbonization, and achieving net-zero targets by 2070 in GS-3 (Environment & Infrastructure).

articles.title: International Seabed Authority Negotiations on Deep-Sea Mining Code
articles.summary: ISA delegates convene to finalize environmental regulations governing polymetallic nodule extraction in the high seas.
prelims: Operates under the framework of the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).
The Area (seabed beyond national jurisdiction) is designated as the 'common heritage of mankind'.
India holds exploration rights for polymetallic nodules in the Central Indian Ocean Basin.
articles.mains: Use to illustrate the tension between Blue Economy resource acquisition and oceanic ecosystem conservation in GS-3 (Environment & Geography).

articles.title: Phase III E-Courts Integration: AI Translation Tools in District Judiciary
articles.summary: Supreme Court e-Committee reviews nationwide scaling of AI tools to translate legal transcripts into scheduled regional languages.
prelims: E-Courts is a Central Sector Scheme funded under the Ministry of Law and Justice.
SUVAS (Supreme Court Vidhik Anuvaad Software) uses AI for translating legal documents.
Phase III focuses on creating cloud-based paperless courts and open-source API architectures.
articles.mains: Incorporate into answers on legal reform, reducing pendency, and strengthening access to justice under Article 39A in GS-2 (Governance).

articles.title: NDMA Issues Guidelines for Sponge City Models in Coastal Metros
articles.summary: National Disaster Management Authority publishes urban drainage and nature-based infrastructure standards to combat recurring pluvial flooding.
prelims: Sponge City concepts prioritize permeable pavements, rain gardens, and wetland restoration.
NDMA functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs, chaired ex-officio by the Prime Minister.
Integrates Sendai Framework Priority 3: Investing in disaster risk reduction for resilience.
articles.mains: Quote as a structural mitigation strategy for urban flooding and climate adaptation in GS-3 (Disaster Management & Urbanization).
